Reset Contract
AP
Resets this life
Realm body and Qi progress: The active realm run, Qi pool, and per-life run counters return to a new-life baseline.
Cultivation active state: Heart Law selection, study state, comprehension, and active cultivation timers are cleared for the new life.
Inventory and currencies: Items and per-life currencies are reset by the inventory owner before the new-life baseline is restored.
Equipment and loadout state: Equipped gear and refinement state are hard-reset with the old body.
Gate trial progress: Trial attempts, clears, bypasses, and active trial sessions are life-scoped.
Carries forward
Ascension Points (AP): Available AP, earned AP, and the new ritual gain remain in the prestige ledger.
Lifetime AP: Lifetime AP earned stays permanent for prestige history and future balancing.
Purchased decrees: Runtime-live prestige purchases remain owned and are reapplied after the reset.
Run history and life count: Prestige count and bounded run history remain in the ledger.
Completed-life summary: The prepared life summary is captured before reset and remains viewable afterward.
Rebuilt next life
City baseline (starter city): City progression is reset and initialized from live content, starting at the first city.
Spirit root (new roll): The prior root is remembered in the life summary, but the next life rolls a fresh root.
Heart Law decree unlocks: Purchased Heart Law tiers are recomputed from live prestige effects when the new life begins.
Technique slot decrees: Purchased technique-slot decrees are recomputed and applied to the technique store.
Hybrid retained
No mastery retention decree active: Technique and recipe mastery reset completely until a Root Memory retention decree is purchased.
